🚨 𝗜 𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗽𝗽𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝗷𝗼𝗯 𝗵𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴.

The “All the best!” comments felt like mockery 😔
Deleted all my LinkedIn posts.
8 months of confidence? Gone.

Wake up → Open Naukri → “500+ applicants” → Apply → Auto-rejected in 2 hours → Repeat 🔁

Then someone said:
“You’re not bad. You’re just too late. Every time.”

By the time I saw jobs on LinkedIn, they were 6–12 hours old.
By the time I applied, HR had shortlisted people who applied in hour 1.

𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀𝗻’𝘁 𝗳𝗮𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴. 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗹𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗲.
